refinement.bcenchantments.ready: Ready for a Trim and an Echo Shard
refinement.bcenchantments.upgrade: Raise it with its trim and %s emeralds at the smithing table
screen.bcenchantments.settings.title: Combat HUD
guide.bcenchantments.title: Field Guide
guide.bcenchantments.open: Field Guide: refining, powers and combinations
guide.bcenchantments.refining.intro: Refine Diamond+ gear, the mace, trident or shield with Emeralds at the Smithing Table.
guide.bcenchantments.refining.levels: Refining a tool increases its Refinement by I, up to V. Each level increases Stats.
guide.bcenchantments.refining.points: At Refinement V Trim Powers unlock and can be forged into the tool
guide.bcenchantments.perks.intro: Powers come only from trims: every armor trim grants its own power on a weapon. Charging powers fill a bar under the crosshair as you land hits and fire when it is full; the rest work on every hit.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.lightning: Strikes the target with lightning at the end of a long combo.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.shockwave: After three swings that each hit a crowd, a shockwave flies out ahead.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.cold_edge: Hits slow their targets. Keep one chilled for three seconds and it freezes solid.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.uppercut: A sword's third swing, a spear's heavy thrust or a mace swung from the ground launches the target into the air.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.chains: Every hit charges it, more when a swing hits several enemies; the charge lasts 8 seconds. When full, nearby enemies and the target are rooted in place for 0.7 seconds.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.echo: Every fourth landed swing echoes: a moment later its targets are struck again. Echoes charge the other bars.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.wind_charged: Enemies you kill burst like a wind charge, hurting and pushing those around them.
guide.bcenchantments.trims.first: Forging a Trim Power onto a tool requires the essence from the Soul Shard, and any Trim.
guide.bcenchantments.trims.raise: Raise Trim Power Levels by enforcing the tool with a new set of the same Trim.
guide.bcenchantments.combining.intro: Powers can be combined by forging a new Trim Power onto an already forged Trim Power to combine their effects and create unique Trim Combinations.
synergy.bcenchantments.chained_lightning: Instead of binding enemies, Chains strikes each of them with half-power lightning and roots them for half a second.
synergy.bcenchantments.charged_lightning: Lightning bursts like a wind charge where it strikes, knocking enemies back.
synergy.bcenchantments.updraft.desc: Uppercut sends you and the target straight up, you twice as high as a block above it and both fall normally. Right click in the air, once per jump: a mace slams down and smashes the ground for one and a half times the damage, a sword dives straight down and cuts everything around where it lands, and a spear, after an Updraft launch, lunges where you look and strikes every enemy it passes through (a spear with Lunge does its own lunge instead). Lunge works in the air only after an Updraft launch.
synergy.bcenchantments.frost_burst.desc: Death bursts chill whatever they catch.
synergy.bcenchantments.resonance.desc: Every echo also sparks a quarter-power lightning bolt on its target.
synergy.bcenchantments.tempest.desc: The shockwave throws enemies much harder; one slammed into a wall takes knockback damage. A mace's smash also hurts enemies within 2.5 blocks of the impact for 30% of its damage.
synergy.bcenchantments.frenzy.desc: On a fully refined weapon, at its top attack speed, Echo strikes every third swing instead of every fourth.
synergy.bcenchantments.shatter.desc: Lightning deals 15% more damage to slowed enemies, and double to enemies frozen solid, which also chills those around them. Kills spread chill to up to 6 enemies nearby.
screen.bcenchantments.forge.title: Weapon Forge
forge.bcenchantments.locked.uppercut: Needs a sword, spear or mace.
forge.bcenchantments.locked.shield: A shield takes Wind Charged or Cold Edge only.
forge.bcenchantments.denied: The weapon forge needs creative mode, operator rights or a singleplayer world.
guide.bcenchantments.trims.shield: Shields do not need any Refinement but can be forged with a few sets of Trims.
guide.bcenchantments.shield.wind_charged: Blocking hits with the shield emits a charged blast in front for 30% of a wind charge's strength. [30s]
guide.bcenchantments.shield.cold_edge: Blocking hits with the shield from melee chills the attacker. [10s]
refinement.bcenchantments.shield.wind_ch: Blocking releases a gust, every 30 s
refinement.bcenchantments.shield.cold_ed: Blocking chills the attacker, every 10 s
guide.bcenchantments.perk.gravity: Every hit pulls the enemies around the target toward it, gathering them for the next swing.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.marked: A hit at point blank marks the target for 5 seconds. The next point-blank hit on it spends the mark and deals 1.5, 2 or 2.5 times the damage.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.rampaging: Killing a monster makes you attack faster for 4 seconds; every further kill refreshes it.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.shared_pain: The damage a kill had to spare goes to the 1, 2 or 3 nearest monsters within 3 blocks, each taking all of it. It goes no further.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.venomous: A hit throws a splash of poison up off the target, once every 8 seconds. Where it lands, enemies get Poison II; if it lands on you, it clears your harmful effects.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.curse: Each hit has a 5, 10 or 15% chance to curse the target with a random harmful effect for a moment.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.plunder: Monsters drop 30, 45 or 60% more. After 7 seconds on the ground, some of the loot turns into emeralds. Bosses sometimes drop everything twice.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.withering: Every 12th hit releases a burst of souls that deals 5 damage and weakens the enemies within 3 blocks. The count lasts 8 seconds.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.shulker_burst: Every 8th hit fires 1, 2 or 3 shulker bullets that home in on random enemies and levitate them for 2 seconds. The count lasts 8 seconds.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.guardian_strik: Three kills within 10 seconds summon a vex that fights for you. It vanishes after 2, 3 or 4 hits.
guide.bcenchantments.perk.copper_shock: Each swing has a 10, 15 or 20% chance to release a copper pulse that jumps through 4, 5 or 6 enemies, hurting each.
synergy.bcenchantments.singularity.desc: The shockwave drags the enemies beside its path into it.
synergy.bcenchantments.black_hole.desc: Every enemy Chains binds pulls the free enemies around it in.
synergy.bcenchantments.cyclone.desc: A kill draws the enemies around it in before its wind burst goes off.
synergy.bcenchantments.launch.desc: A launching swing on a marked mob throws its targets 1.3 times higher, and you go up after them.
synergy.bcenchantments.blast_step.desc: A kill by a point-blank hit on a marked mob bursts you onward, into the next enemy. Once per swing.
synergy.bcenchantments.thunderwave.desc: Every enemy the shockwave cuts is struck by a quarter-power lightning bolt.
synergy.bcenchantments.lightning_rod.des: Before the bolt lands, the enemies within 5 blocks are pulled to the target.
synergy.bcenchantments.thunder_charge.de: Spending a mark adds 3 hits of Lightning charge.
synergy.bcenchantments.storm_frenzy.desc: While rampaging, Lightning charges twice as fast.
synergy.bcenchantments.skybreaker.desc: Launched targets are struck by a half-power bolt at the top of their flight.
synergy.bcenchantments.toxic_storm.desc: Every bolt leaves a Venomous poison splash where it strikes.
synergy.bcenchantments.hexbolt.desc: Every curse that lands also calls a quarter-power bolt on its target.
synergy.bcenchantments.gilded_storm.desc: A kill by the weapon's lightning drops three times the loot.
synergy.bcenchantments.black_lightning.d: Every bolt releases a Withering soul burst where it strikes.
synergy.bcenchantments.shulker_storm.des: Each Shulker Burst bullet that hits calls a quarter-power bolt on its target.
synergy.bcenchantments.arc.desc: A lightning kill's overkill reaches Shared Pain's enemies as lightning bolts.
synergy.bcenchantments.static_guard.desc: Your vexes strike what they hit with a quarter-power bolt.
synergy.bcenchantments.copper_storm.desc: Each enemy a Copper Shock pulse reaches has a 50% chance to be struck by a quarter-power bolt.
synergy.bcenchantments.gale_echo.desc: Echo strikes push their targets back like a small gust.
synergy.bcenchantments.whiplash.desc: When Chains fires, the bound enemies are yanked to the target.
synergy.bcenchantments.hurricane.desc: While rampaging, death bursts are 50% wider.
synergy.bcenchantments.toxic_gust.desc: Death bursts poison what they catch (Poison II, 1.5 s).
synergy.bcenchantments.hexwind.desc: Each enemy a death burst catches has a 40% chance to be cursed.
synergy.bcenchantments.windfall.desc: Each drop has a 25% chance to charge up and burst like a wind charge 1 s later, dealing 2 damage.
synergy.bcenchantments.ashen_wind.desc: Death bursts also release a Withering soul burst.
synergy.bcenchantments.shulker_gust.desc: Shulker Burst bullets that hit throw their target back like a small gust.
synergy.bcenchantments.shrapnel.desc: Every monster Shared Pain's overkill reaches bursts like a wind charge for 4 damage.
synergy.bcenchantments.bulwark_gust.desc: Death bursts throw enemies away from you.
synergy.bcenchantments.spark_burst.desc: Every enemy a death burst pushes zaps the nearest other enemy with Copper Shock.

tooltip.bcenchantments.combine.first: A trim and an echo shard grant its power
tooltip.bcenchantments.combine.new_pair: The next trim starts a new pair
tooltip.bcenchantments.combine.title: Next trim combines:
guide.bcenchantments.trims.combine: An additional Trim forged onto an existing non-combined Trim Power, combines both Trims and grants exclusive Powers.
panel.bcenchantments.empty: Put a weapon or shield in the middle slot to see its stats, powers and what to do next.
panel.bcenchantments.empty.steps: Emeralds refine a weapon to level V. Then a trim template and an echo shard grant the trim's power, and every two powers combine.
panel.bcenchantments.other: Armor trims work as usual. Weapons and shields gain Trim Powers here.
panel.bcenchantments.next_level: Each level: +0.05 attack speed, one random boost to damage, crit chance or crit damage, and a level point to spend.
panel.bcenchantments.points.how: Click a stat to spend a point. Spent points stay.
panel.bcenchantments.how_refine: Template slot empty, emeralds or emerald blocks on the right.
panel.bcenchantments.degrade_warning: No Trim or Emerald will be refunded.
panel.bcenchantments.how_trim: Trim template on the left, echo shard on the right.
panel.bcenchantments.no_partner: No trim combines with it yet.
panel.bcenchantments.none_carried: None for a new power. The Field Guide (?) lists every trim.
panel.bcenchantments.shield_none: A shield needs no refinement: a trim and an echo shard grant one of these.
panel.bcenchantments.why.refined_bare: Fully refined, Trim & Echo Shard required
panel.bcenchantments.why.refined: Fully refined: it takes trims now. A power's trim and 64 emeralds raise it.
panel.bcenchantments.why.gems: Refining takes emeralds or emerald blocks.
panel.bcenchantments.why.level: Refine to level V before adding trims.
panel.bcenchantments.why.unbuilt: This trim's power is not in the game yet.
panel.bcenchantments.why.max: %s is already at its highest level.
panel.bcenchantments.difficulty.no_weapo: No weapon with Trim Powers: monsters take no notice.
panel.bcenchantments.difficulty.not_adap: Monsters have not adapted to a power yet.
